notes_for_human: Two unresolved conflicts to flag before use. (1) Underrepresented-group / race-ethnicity eligibility language: one WebFetch pass of career.seo-usa.org/apply-faq/ returned the sentence "All are welcome to apply" with no race/ethnicity self-identification item in the eligibility checklist; a separate WebFetch pass of the same URL and independent WebSearch results state the eligibility list includes "Self-Identify as Black, Latinx, or Native-American" and that SEO Career is described elsewhere (e.g. career.seo-usa.org press pages, third-party partner pages) as being for "high-achieving Black, Hispanic and Native American college students." These two readings of the same page are inconsistent — likely reflects either page content changing between fetches, an AI-summarization inconsistency in the WebFetch tool, or a genuine ambiguity on the live page. This needs a direct human/browser check of https://career.seo-usa.org/apply-faq/ to resolve before treating either version as fact. (2) No 2027-specific deadline dates were found anywhere on career.seo-usa.org in this pass — only general rolling-basis / 'Success Class typically closes in mid-April' language and unrelated references to a 2025-26 cycle (Jan 31, 2026 deadline) surfaced by search. GPA and major details found but not requested by the schema: '3.2 GPA required (3.0 may be considered)', 'All Majors', 'Accredited 4-Year University' — all from career.seo-usa.org/apply-faq/, checked 2026-07-29.
